Global options such as `--base-url`, `--tenant` and `--json` go before the command — see [CLI reference](./index.mdx#global-options). Exit codes are listed in [Exit codes](./exit-codes.md).

## apiome schema {#schema}

Download and diff published specs; test payloads against schemas.

```text
apiome schema [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`arazzo`](#schema-arazzo), [`diff`](#schema-diff), [`json`](#schema-json), [`test`](#schema-test).

## apiome schema arazzo {#schema-arazzo}

Download a published version's Arazzo workflows.

Fetches GET /v1/arazzo/{tenant}/{project}/{version}, or the per-class route with --class, and writes the document byte for byte as served. A summary with its sha256 checksum goes to stderr (with --json, a JSON line: on stdout when --output is a file, on stderr when the document goes to stdout).

Exit codes: 0 written; 6 --expect-sha256 did not match (nothing written); 2 bad usage, or the version or class is unknown, unpublished, or private without an API key; 1 a transport or server error.

```text
apiome schema arazzo [OPTIONS] TENANT/PROJECT/VERSION
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `REF` | text | yes | Published version by slugs, e.g. acme-corp/payments-api/2.1.0. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--class` | text |  |  | Download only this class's workflows (the per-class route). |
| `--format` | text | `yaml` |  | json or yaml (default yaml, the usual form for Arazzo). |
| `--output`, `-o` | text | `-` |  | File to write, or - for stdout (default). |
| `--expect-sha256` | text |  |  | Fail with exit 6, writing nothing, unless the document has this SHA-256. |

## apiome schema diff {#schema-diff}

Compare two published versions: paths, classes and properties.

Both sides are fetched from the public GET /v1/schema/{tenant}/{project}/{version} (no login; APIOME_API_KEY is sent for private versions) and compared in the CLI. A version typed as v2.1.0 that is not found is retried as 2.1.0. This lists what changed; to grade changes as breaking, use apiome versions compatibility.

Exit codes: 0 done (with --exit-code: identical); 1 with --exit-code, differences found; 2 bad usage, or a version is unknown, unpublished or private without a key. Without --exit-code a transport or server error exits 1; with it, 2, so 1 always means "differs".

```text
apiome schema diff [OPTIONS] TENANT/PROJECT V1 V2
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PROJECT_REF` | text | yes | Project by slugs, e.g. acme-corp/payments-api. |
| `BASE_VERSION` | text | yes | Base (older) published version, e.g. 2.0.0. |
| `HEAD_VERSION` | text | yes | Head (newer) published version, e.g. 2.1.0. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--format` | text | `summary` |  | summary (default), unified, sarif or json. Global --json means json. |
| `--scope` | text | `all` |  | Compare paths, schemas or all (default). |
| `--ignore` | text (repeatable) |  |  | Drop a kind of change (repeatable): description-only. |
| `--exit-code` | flag |  |  | Git-like: exit 1 if there are differences, 0 if identical. |
| `--output`, `-o` | text | `-` |  | File to write, or - for stdout (default). |

## apiome schema json {#schema-json}

Download a published version's JSON Schema.

Fetches GET /v1/json/{tenant}/{project}/{version}, or the per-class route with --class, and streams the document byte for byte as served (no transformation), so it pipes straight into code generators. A summary with its sha256 checksum goes to stderr (with --json, a JSON line: on stdout when --output is a file, on stderr when the document goes to stdout).

Exit codes: 0 written; 6 --expect-sha256 did not match (nothing written); 2 bad usage, or the version or class is unknown, unpublished, or private without an API key; 1 a transport or server error.

```text
apiome schema json [OPTIONS] TENANT/PROJECT/VERSION
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `REF` | text | yes | Published version by slugs, e.g. acme-corp/payments-api/2.1.0. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--class` | text |  |  | Download only this class's schema (the per-class route). |
| `--format` | text | `json` |  | json (default) or yaml. |
| `--output`, `-o` | text | `-` |  | File to write, or - for stdout (default). |
| `--expect-sha256` | text |  |  | Fail with exit 6, writing nothing, unless the document has this SHA-256. |

## apiome schema test {#schema-test}

Run schema tests server-side and gate on the verdicts.

Exit codes: 0 every case passed; 6 at least one case failed (a payload's verdict did not match its expectation, or a mutant did not violate its intended constraint); 1 a case could not be checked at all, a transport/server fault, or an empty run; 2 bad usage, rejected credentials, or a schema reference the server refused (any 4xx).

```text
apiome schema test [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--schema` | text |  | yes | Path-shaped schema reference: project/{slug}/{version}/{type}, catalog/{item}/{version}/{type}, or registry/{namespace}/{name}; the trailing /{type} segment is optional. {version} is a version label, a revision id, or 'latest'. |
| `--payload` | path (repeatable) |  |  | Payload file to validate (repeatable). JSON by default; *.xml is sent as XML. |
| `--generate` / `--no-generate` | flag | `--no-generate` |  | Run the generated set: valid instances plus single-constraint mutants, each verified server-side. Default: off, except in --suite mode where it is on. |
| `--suite` | path |  |  | Suite mode: a directory of saved payload files (all expected valid), or an IXH-1.1 corpus manifest whose 'instance-payload' entries are run with expectations from validity_class. Also runs the generated set unless --no-generate. |
| `--seed` | integer range | `0` |  | Synthesis seed: the same schema and seed generate byte-identical payloads. |
| `--junit` | path |  |  | Write the run as JUnit XML to this file ('-' for stdout). |
